info.title: Cerul API
info.description: The public Cerul API contract shared by cloud and local runtimes. Runtime availability is discovered through GET /v1/capabilities.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Isolated Web, Desktop, CLI, and MCP authentication protocols

tags.name: Artifacts
tags.description: Structured, renderable outputs and human review

post.summary: Start CLI or MCP device authorization
Exchange or refresh an isolated Desktop, CLI, or MCP credential

get.summary: List workspaces visible to the authenticated identity
Get a workspace-scoped usage and credit report
Get the server-authoritative identity, Workspace role, and scopes
Get the effective plan, capability grants, limits, and credit reservations
List API credential metadata without secret material

post.summary: Create a scoped API credential and return its secret once

201.description: API credential created; secret is never returned again

delete.summary: Revoke a Workspace API credential idempotently

204.description: API credential revoked or already revoked

get.summary: Get a published, non-revoked public Share projection

Cache-Control.description: Briefly cacheable and revalidated; never immutable

404.description: Missing, expired, and revoked Shares are all reported as not_found

get.summary: List capabilities available in the selected runtime

200.description: Capability registry projection for this runtime

get.summary: List libraries visible to the caller

post.summary: Add an asset to a library
Create an isomorphic local or cloud upload session
Create an ingestion job for an asset
Search scoped libraries and assets for evidence
Create a capability or workflow job
Request idempotent cancellation of a job

get.summary: List artifacts created by a job

post.summary: Record an accept, reject, or revision event for an artifact

delete.summary: Delete an Agent session without deleting scoped assets

shared_by.description: Public display label, never an identity or Workspace identifier

clip_url.description: Revocable application-service URL; never a storage key

poster_url.description: Revocable application-service URL; never a storage key

media_expires_at.description: Expiry for signed media URLs; null only for request-time revocation proxies

secret.description: One-time secret; only a hash is retained
